summary: Comfort settings and content notes (plan 3 and 13.6, G9; story/comfort.gd). Each topic is a playthrough option `show_<id>`, off by default: with it off, the scenes that carry that topic are softened (a cutscene take or a Narrator variant written for the full version carries `option:show_<id>` in its `when`, and the softened one follows it), so comfort is on unless the player turns a topic up. Each region's loading card names the topics its chapter holds (`notes`) and any other warning in our own words (`also`). The notes are ours, from the chapter digests; check them against the book's own content notes.

topics.name: Burning alive
topics.tip: Off: a person burning is shown as a silhouette against the flames, or the scene cuts away and you hear it.

topics.name: Surgery and needles
topics.tip: Off: operations, needles and stitching happen out of sight, told by sound and aftermath.

topics.name: Insects and crawling things
topics.tip: Off: swarms and close-ups of insects, centipedes and worms are kept to shadows and sound.

topics.name: Harm to children
topics.tip: Off: harm that comes to children is never shown; the scene cuts away before it.

topics.name: Hanging
topics.tip: Off: hanged figures and nooses are shown only as shadows, or not at all.

wickermoor.also: Disappearances, a village with secrets, grief.

crooked_house.also: A haunted house, body horror, a hag who keeps children.

foxwillow.also: Scarecrows, a corn maze, grief for lost family.

drowned_crossroads.also: Drowning, deals for souls, a withering curse.

memorys_rest.also: An asylum, mistreated patients, lost memories.

skitterdeep_mine.also: Plague, a mine collapse, giant centipedes.

hartsblight_forest.also: Revelry turned cruel, the walking dead.

crooked_nightmare.also: A nightmare of the house reborn, body horror.
